# Every key of the `HostClassDecl` JSON the SDKs send the poll core, one per
# line, `section.key` for the nested declarations. Six readers pin it: a
# `flz_core` test serialises a fully populated declaration and asserts its key
# set is exactly this; `HostClassDeclarationTest` asserts the Java builder emits
# every key here; `sdk/node/test/decl-keys.test.mjs` asserts the same of the
# Node builder; `sdk/ruby/test/decl_keys_test.rb` of the Ruby builder;
# `sdk/php/tests/DeclKeysTest.php` of the PHP builder; and
# `sdk/python/tests/test_decl_keys.py` of the Python builder. A key the core
# learns that a builder cannot spell is a red build for that SDK; a key a
# builder invents that the core never learned already fails at
# `deny_unknown_fields`.
#
# Adding a key: teach the core, add it here, teach the Rust, Java, Node, Ruby,
# PHP and Python builders — one change, every SDK (docs/architecture/runner.md).
class.factory_id
class.persistent
class.sdk_lang
class.sdk_version
class.change_format_id
class.effectively_once
class.checkpoint_ack
class.checkpoint_every
class.checkpoint_outputs

class.beyond_window_policy
class.compact_after_bytes
class.sync_durability
